methodProvenance.partAnchoringRule: R-8, decided from source: a part is admitted only where the DS stamps data-part with that name, or a DS component-identity class pair matches. Scout prose is corroboration, not authority.

hostConditionAnchors.reason: Viewport, input-modality or platform conditions of the HOST. Neither an interaction state nor a customization axis of this family.

engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Engine siblings exist for classic, modern and rustic. Only modern and rustic emit data-part anchors and read --ds-* channels; the classic engine is an Ant Design wrapper with zero data-part attributes and zero --ds-* reads, so the entire part anatomy below is unaddressable under engine=classic. Modern and rustic also differ in parts: rustic emits item, meta and root parts that modern does not name identically.
